name: open_url
description: Fetch a single web page (Firecrawl-backed) and return its full content as markdown. Use after `web_search` to read the most relevant result, or when the user gives you a URL directly. Returns `{title, link, full_content, published_date?, scrape_successful}`. If the scrape fails, `scrape_successful` is false and `full_content` may be empty — fall back to telling the user rather than fabricating.
